hits.title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
hits.abstract_snippet: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. hits.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
hits.abstract_snippet: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks.
